cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have the dog fed and ready at eleven. I agreed to watch him today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train won't get in until midnight. It's only another hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring him to the station, then. Meet me before the clock changes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you loved him. Let him sleep.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He can sleep in my car while we wait. I said today; I'll hand you the lead before midnight.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 today boundary and A3 station accommodation fit the pair, but the handover cannot happen as A specifies under B arrival time.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 train arrives at midnight; A3 and A5 require B at station before midnight, a direct timing contradiction.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants the dog to sleep and refers to A affection, a plausible concern.

heightening.evidence: A5 sleeping-in-car answer adapts B4 but still depends on an impossible earlier handover.

specificity.evidence: A1 eleven versus B2 midnight is explicit; A5 before-midnight promise violates it.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 literalism is playable only if B can physically meet the boundary, not through an unstated earlier train.
